First review gate — prior beside corrected

The choreography, timing, joint trajectories, poses and the newer hair design are unchanged from the prior animation (5bcd74f). What changed is fitting and construction: the hairstyle is now anchored to each frame's own skull instead of being placed at one fixed position, so roots, hairline and temples follow the head as it moves; and Super Saiyan 4 has a bare chest with real definition under a crimson shoulder mantle instead of a procedural patch. Two transitions only — Normal to SSJ1 and SSJ3 to SSJ4 — as the gate asks.
